verdict.rationale: MX is a financial-data API platform, so user-configured background automations are a fair question, but the pack documents no way for users to create or schedule their own automations. The closest items are adjacent: a fixed vendor-run daily aggregation (mx-docs-25) and event webhooks (mx-docs-7), which are developer building blocks rather than user-defined autonomous automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
